doc.name: SeatCanvas
doc.description: Web-based seating chart planner for weddings, quinceañeras, galas, and events. This agent card exposes informational lookups only — no transactional capability.

skills.name: Product info lookup
skills.description: Read product overview, pricing tiers, free-tier limits, supported languages, and feature list.

skills.name: Pricing lookup
skills.description: Read current free-tier limits and Event Pass price. No checkout, no write operations.
examples: How much is the Event Pass?

skills.name: FAQ search
skills.description: Read FAQ entries from the Help page.
examples: How do I import a guest list?

skills.name: Blog search
skills.description: Read blog post index and individual posts about seating chart planning.
